faqs.a: Canvas Dx is the first FDA-authorized AI-based diagnostic aid for autism spectrum disorder. It helps clinicians diagnose ASD in children ages 18 months to 6 years by combining caregiver questionnaires, video analysis, and provider assessments.
Canvas Dx has 95% specificity (correctly identifying children without ASD) and 97% negative predictive value. It was validated in clinical trials and received FDA De Novo authorization in 2021.
Canvas Dx is a prescription-only diagnostic device that must be ordered by a licensed healthcare provider such as a pediatrician, developmental pediatrician, or child psychiatrist.

faqs.q: How much does Canvas Dx cost?
faqs.a: Canvas Dx typically costs $300-600 per assessment. It may be covered by commercial insurance or Medicaid in some states. Health systems can get volume pricing for broader implementation.
